$comment: Seeded asymmetry and twitches (the user's infected spec steps 3–4, ADR-159). Every infected body draws its own quirks once, from a seed of place + Act 4 day + its index, so a run plays the same twice and no two bodies move alike. Chase never rises above the tier's speed: you can still outrun the Fresh and Degraded, barely (ADR-32/49).
